SELECT TOP 200 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%tenofovir%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%adefovir%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%entecavir%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%lamivudine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%telbivudine%') AND (standard_concept='S' OR standard_concept='C') AND concept_class_id IN ('Ingredient','Clinical Drug','Clinical Drug Form','Branded Drug','Branded Drug Form','Quant Clinical Drug','Clinical Dose Group') ORDER BY concept_name

SELECT TOP 50 measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS persons, MIN(measurement_date) AS min_date, MAX(measurement_date) AS max_date FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=m.measurement_concept_id WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hepatitis b virus dna%' GROUP BY measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name ORDER BY n DESC
